'''Pypey''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Ithorian]] [[Youngling|child]] and the [[Gender|son]] of [[Oora]], living on the [[planet]] [[Takobo]] a few [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]]. He was targeted for abduction or assassination by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]] [[Fifth Brother]] and [[Seventh Sister]], but was rescued by rebels [[Garazeb Orrelios]], [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Ezra Bridger]], and [[Ahsoka Tano]] and reunited with his [[Parent|mother]]. Before being reunited with his mother he attempted to grab Ezra's blade, but was unable.<ref name="The Future of the Force" />

Prior to being rescued by members of the rebel [[Phoenix Cell]], Pypey lived with his mother [[Oora]] in the [[Hammertown]] district of [[Takobo City]]<ref name="The Future of the Force" />—the capital of the planet [[Takobo]].<ref name="Concept">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-future-of-the-force-concept-art-gallery|text="The Future of the Force" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|slide 6}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pypey was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voices [[Captain]] [[Rex]], [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]], and many other characters in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. Though the child's name is given as "Pypey" in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]],<ref name="datapypey" /> both the closing credits and captions of "[[The Future of the Force]]" give the spelling "Pipey."<ref name="The Future of the Force" /> He was originally going to be named "Pypie," but the spelling was changed during production.<ref name="Concept Art">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-future-of-the-force-concept-art-gallery|text="The Future of the Force" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|slide 3}}</ref> The house that [[Oora]] and Pypey live in features a cloth with the same repeating pattern that is sewn or printed on the material that [[Alora]] is swaddled in.
